title: Jump input ignored, no airborne movement detected
explanation: A jump_pressed event occurs at frame 207, but there is no player_moved event with a negative y velocity in the next three frames (208‑210) and no later player_moved or player_landed events showing airborne motion. This contradicts the expected behavior that a jump should result in upward velocity, indicating the jump was ignored.
suspected_code: player_input/jump_handling or physics integration for vertical movement
